g.text: Sequence Diagram - AA03 Role Resolution on Every Protected Request (e.g. GET /api/v1/stock)
Roles and the active state are read from the database on EVERY protected request,
so role removals and deactivations (AA06) take effect immediately, without a new login.
The "roles" claim inside the JWT and any role sent by the client are ignored.
Every error branch ends the interaction: the business controller is never reached.
Every thrown error goes through errorHandler and is returned as { error: { message, status } }.
[A) Token missing, malformed, expired or with an invalid signature]
{ error: { message: "Invalid or expired token", status: 401 } }
roles cannot be confirmed -> request denied;
next() is never called (fail closed, BR 9)
corrupted stored data is a server fault,
never a "400 Bad Request" of the client.
message sanitized; request denied (fail closed, BR 9)
{ error: { message: "Invalid or expired token", status: 401 } }
{ error: { message: "Account is not active", status: 403 } }
[No role left (all roles removed after login)]
throw AppError("No active role is assigned
{ error: { message: "No active role is assigned to this account", status: 403 } }
